focus_areas: Adhesion of sesame seeds to the crust (no floating/melting)
Geometric consistency of the wire cooling rack grid
Specular highlights on the glaze (natural reflection vs. AI smear)
Boundary sharpness between bagel and background/rack
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the sesame seeds and the bagel surface. In AI images, toppings often look like they are painted on or float slightly above the surface. Also, inspect the wire rack in the background; AI often struggles with repeating geometric patterns like grids, causing them to warp or disconnect illogically.
image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of several golden-brown bagels resting on a black wire cooling rack. The central bagel is in sharp focus, featuring a glossy crust and a generous topping of white sesame seeds. Other bagels are partially visible in the background and foreground, creating a sense of depth and abundance.

To confirm the specific taxonomic classification of the object as a bagel and distinguish it from similar round breads like donuts or brioche buns.
To verify that the sesame seeds are physically adhered to the surface and not floating or melting into the crust, and to check for edge bleeding between the bagel and the wire rack.
To assess general image fidelity, checking for subtle texture anomalies in the bread crumb or seed distribution that might indicate AI generation artifacts.
